12% of remote listings now require AI skills. What does that mean for your career?

Our latest data snapshot of 3,928 remote listings shows 487 (12%) explicitly require AI skills. Top pay: Jabil offers USD 132,400–238,400/year for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer. AI requirements appear at Jabil, Sardine, Sycle LLC, Creator, HSS Careers, Censys, and Devoted Studios.

But not every AI-titled job pays premium. 78% of listings hide salary. Communication (41%) still leads as the most demanded skill.
